user.title: Set up Simulated Inverter
user.description: Creates the Simulated Inverter device: a full simulated hybrid-inverter sensor suite (grid meter, PV string controller, battery BMS, weather probes) modeled after Huawei FusionSolar and SolaX Power hardware, driven entirely by your existing solar/wind/battery/grid simulation packages. Only one instance is needed.

abort.already_configured: Simulated Inverter is already set up.
